one_line: Demonstrates how chin augmentation alters the perception of nose size using visual comparisons and pixel-change data.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen comparison of a woman's face asks if her nose is too big, then reveals it is the same nose.
hook.why_it_works: Triggers self-consciousness about facial features and immediately subverts expectations with a visual puzzle.

shots.description: Split-screen before/after comparison of a woman's face with a sliding divider.
Heatmap overlay showing pixel changes, accompanied by a bar chart of regional changes.
Interactive text prompt instructing the viewer to push their lower jaw forward.
Side-by-side comparison of the original and edited faces, transitioning to a search bar CTA.

devices.name: sliding divider
devices.what_it_is: A vertical line that slides across the face to reveal the edited version.
devices.used_for: Showing the subtle difference between before and after states.

devices.name: pixel heatmap
devices.what_it_is: A glowing overlay highlighting areas of the image that were modified.
devices.used_for: Proving scientifically that the nose area was untouched.

devices.name: bar chart
devices.what_it_is: A simple bar graph showing percentage of pixel changes by facial region.
devices.used_for: Quantifying the visual edit to build credibility.

devices.name: search bar mockup
devices.what_it_is: An on-screen search input field typing out the brand name.
devices.used_for: Directing user search behavior for the CTA.

Almost none of it is on her nose.
When the chin sits back, the nose stands out

Your nose just got smaller. You didn't touch it.

narrative_arc: Deconstruct the illusion using a chin-adjustment comparison.
Provide data-driven proof of the optical illusion.
Engage the viewer with a physical, real-time experiment.
Introduce the AI tool as a personalized solution to preview these changes.

cta.what: Search Refina AI to preview facial adjustments on your own face.

subjects: Unnamed woman acting as the visual model for the facial structure demonstration.
what_makes_it_work: Uses an interactive physical test ('push your jaw forward') to make the optical illusion immediately real to the viewer.
Leverages data visualization (pixel heatmap and bar chart) to build scientific authority.

animations.name: Before/After Slider
animations.what_moves: Vertical divider line and image masks
animations.purpose: Demonstrates subtle facial changes by sweeping between before and after states.
animations.reusable_as: Comparing any two states of an image, like color grading or editing.

animations.name: Chin Region Highlight
animations.what_moves: Oval outline and horizontal sweep line
animations.purpose: Draws immediate focus to the specific area of the face that was modified.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting specific UI elements or product features in a demo.

animations.name: Growing Bar Chart
animations.purpose: Quantifies the pixel changes to prove scientifically where the modification occurred.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying survey results, performance metrics, or data comparisons.

animations.name: Dashed Circle Callouts
animations.what_moves: Dashed circular indicators and text labels
animations.purpose: Isolates the nose and chin to explain the optical illusion of size perception.
animations.reusable_as: Labeling parts of a diagram, map, or product photo.

animations.name: Interactive Step List
animations.purpose: Guides the viewer through a physical exercise to experience the illusion firsthand.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying recipes, onboarding steps, or tutorial phases.

animations.name: Side-by-Side Panel Slide
animations.purpose: Compares the full before and after faces side-by-side for final evaluation.
animations.reusable_as: Comparing two distinct products, options, or variations.

animations.name: Search Input Typing
animations.purpose: Prompts the user to search for the brand name on the web.
animations.reusable_as: Call-to-action screens directing users to search or visit a URL.
